facts.fact: TechReviewAfrica reports Namibia has legally recognised electronic signatures, allowing businesses and public institutions to conclude contracts and submit trade documents electronically, but names no instrument.

TechReviewAfrica reports Namibia's legal recognition of electronic signatures is a step towards implementing its obligations under Article 8 of the AfCFTA Protocol on Digital Trade, citing an AfCFTA Secretariat expert; no Namibian instrument or date is named.

NAM.note: The document names no Namibian membership, agreement, meeting or seat in an African digital policy body.
